name: OpenAI API
how_to_set: Use prepaid billing with auto recharge OFF (or a monthly recharge limit).
Create one project per app and environment; Project > Limits: set a hard spend limit (requests get 429 above it).
Organization > Limits: set an organization hard limit as the outer cap.
kill_switch: Hard spend limit returns 429 for the project; revoke the project key to stop at once.
traps: Spend alerts do not stop anything; only the hard limit does
Enforcement lags, so spend can pass the limit slightly
